image_description: Three patterned baby bibs laid flat on a wooden surface. The bibs are arranged in an overlapping fan shape from left to right: orange with white polka dots, grey with light blue polka dots, and green with white polka dots. Each bib has a curved neck opening and visible snap fasteners at the back of the neck. The bibs appear to be made of fabric with a soft texture.
